name: telegram-channel
description: Telegram channel for a stock Codex App Server with explicit local access control.

interface.shortDescription: Talk to one Codex session through a Telegram bot.
interface.longDescription: A Telegram channel for stock Codex. Its terminal launcher owns one App Server and one non-evicting Telegram poller, while signed handles bind replies and attachments to their admitted origin.
defaultPrompt: Use connect only for the host-provided current thread, then use only signed Telegram handles supplied by the channel.
